profile.protocol: one non-retained final-runtime launch per qualified budget

input_staging.reason: Final real-product upload medians are 0.18232 ms Ordinary and 0.176256 ms fixed-D2 at budget 140 versus 228.644 ms and 228.8655 ms tower time. Two staging slots and cancellation state would target less than 0.08% of the measured tower boundary.

cuda_graphs.reason: Even perfect removal of every measured inter-kernel gap has only a 1.63%, 0.46%, and 0.11% upper bound at budgets 70, 140, and 280. Actual replay gain must be smaller and would add graph-private capacity plus shape-specific update and recovery state.
cuda_graphs.shape_constraint: The qualified square, wide, and tall grids change attention masking and pooling parameters within each budget; three budget-only captures cannot safely represent all admitted shapes without per-request graph-node parameter updates.
cuda_graphs.reopen_condition: Reopen only if a future final-runtime Nsight Systems profile shows launch or host gaps are material after the attention kernel changes, with graph-private bytes admitted into capacity.

claim_boundary: Screening decision only; no CUDA Graph or double-buffered staging performance claim is made.
